title: Certified release-cut Production classifier compatibility adapter

phases.objective: Preserve the existing fail-closed E2E Production classifier while adapting the immutable release-cut branch identity emitted by the governed promotion controller to the already-reviewed reconciliation evaluator without mutating remote refs or requiring current main to remain equal to the certified cut.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A governed Production candidate uses release/production-candidate-<release-cut-12>-<Production-12>-<launcher-run>-<attempt> and targets the exact pinned Production SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The candidate is accepted only when it is the exact two-parent immutable release-cut candidate, its tree equals the release-cut tree, pinned Production remains exact, Production is contained by the release cut, and the release cut remains an ancestor of current main even when main has advanced.
steps: Parse only the controller-owned four-component release-cut candidate namespace with positive launcher run and attempt identifiers.
Read current main and Production through the same authenticated read-only protected-ref transport used by the existing classifier, or tokenless git ls-remote only in synthetic/local execution.
Require current Production to equal the PR base exactly and to match the embedded Production prefix.
Require exactly two candidate parents: certified release cut first and pinned Production second.
Require the first parent to match the embedded release-cut prefix and require the candidate tree to equal the first-parent tree byte-for-byte.
Require pinned Production to be an ancestor of the certified release cut.
Allow current main to advance only while the certified release cut remains its ancestor.

Evaluate the candidate through an isolated temporary Git clone whose local canonical-main ref is pinned to the certified release cut, preserving the reviewed legacy evaluator without altering remote refs.
Reject stale Production, release-cut ancestry loss, wrong trees, malformed prefixes, wrong parent order/count, and malformed branch identities fail closed.
assertions: The new adapter does not broaden legacy SHA-bound or bridge candidate namespaces.
Remote main, Production, candidate, and protected refs are never mutated.
Current main equality with the release cut is not required; release-cut ancestry is required instead.
Production must remain exactly equal to the pinned base SHA.
The candidate tree must remain byte-identical to the certified release cut.
The candidate must preserve Production as its exact second parent and the release cut as its exact first parent.
Legacy classifier behavior remains delegated unchanged for every non-release-cut branch identity.
No deployment, SQL, migration Apply, grant, provider call, credential payload read, external send, protected-ref write, or force update occurs.

phases.objective: Observe the compatibility adapter on governed Production candidate PR events while preserving exact protected-ref readback.
Retain fail-closed diagnostics for protected-ref transport failure, ancestry loss, malformed candidate identity, parent drift, and tree drift.
Validate one release-cut candidate with advanced current main and explicit negative stale-Production and spoof cases before Production promotion.
Require exact classifier evidence on the fresh governed Production candidate without granting merge or deployment authority.
